Meet F10 Lightrunner. Fast. Far. Autonomous. Explore F10 See it in action Mission-ready. Day or Night. Skydio’s autonomous flying robots help our most critical industries see farther, respond faster, and go where people can’t—or shouldn’t have to. Inside and out, rain or shine. DFR Respond to 911 calls for service in under two minutes, and put eyes on the scene for instant situational awareness and greater safety. Physical Security Protect every site, around the clock. Automate patrols, verify alarms in seconds, and get eyes on threats before sending anyone into harm’s way. Asset Inspection Capture every detail, every cycle. Know the true condition of your assets and catch issues before they become outages, shutdowns, or safety incidents. Mapping Get decision-grade data, autonomously. Precision you can repeat, with full coverage in complex spaces and consistent, comparable data over time. National Security Out-see, out-think, and out-do the adversary. Gather data faster, smarter, and safer with survivable sUAS that keep teams out of harm’s way. A family of flying robots. F10 Lightrunner MegaDock F10 Lightrunner is an autonomous, dock-based fixed-wing flying robot built for long-range, rapid-response missions that reach well beyond the coverage of a multirotor aircraft. X10 Dock for X10 X10 is a highly versatile autonomous flying robot capable of operation from 1ft to 400ft and in urban canyons, with powerful visual and radiometric thermal sensors. R10 R10 is a compact indoor flying robot built to navigate confined, cluttered, and zero-light spaces—from a building interior to a tank or tunnel—so you can risk the machine, not the person. Designed for the work you do. Robots do the flying. Skydio Command software runs the missions and turns them into repeatable, automated operations at scale. DFR Command DFR Command turns a 911 call for service into live intelligence for a safer, more effective response. Learn more Security Command Security Command turns fleets of Skydio flying robots into a scalable physical security force. Learn more Asset Command Asset Command connects your physical infrastructure to autonomous drone operations, organizing inspection and response around each asset record. Learn more ISR Command ISR Command orchestrates fleets of X10Ds to deliver scalable, collaborative, and persistent coverage in contested environments. Learn more Working together on one common platform. Serving our most critical industries. Accept All Decline All Cookie Manager How We Use Cookies When you visit our website, we store cookies on your browser to collect information. The information collected might relate to you, your preferences or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to and to provide a more personalized web experience. However, you can choose not to allow certain types of cookies, which may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings according to your preference. You cannot opt-out of our First Party Strictly Necessary Cookies as they are deployed in order to ensure the proper functioning of our website (such as prompting the cookie banner and remembering your settings, to log into your account, to redirect you when you log out, etc.). For more information about the First and Third Party Cookies used please follow this link. Our Privacy Policy Allow All Manage Consent Preferences Strictly Necessary Cookies Always Active These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information. Other Cookies Other Cookies Skydio uses these cookies to improve and personalize your experience on our website. You can opt out of all or some of them here. Performance Cookies Switch Label These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance. Targeting Cookies Switch Label These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
